dao.description: Returns the address of the DAO this module belongs to

delegation_module.description:
Gets the address of the delegation module associated with this
proposal module (if any).

get_vote.description: Returns a voters position on a propsal.

list_proposals.description:
Lists all the proposals that have been cast in this
module.

limit.description:
The maximum number of proposals to return as part of this
query. If no limit is set a max of 30 proposals will be
returned.

start_after.description:
The proposal ID to start listing proposals after. For
example, if this is set to 2 proposals with IDs 3 and
higher will be returned.

list_votes.description:
Lists all of the votes that have been cast on a
proposal.

limit.description:
The maximum number of votes to return in response to this
query. If no limit is specified a max of 30 are returned.

proposal_id.description: The proposal to list the votes of.

start_after.description:
The voter to start listing votes after. Ordering is done
alphabetically.

next_proposal_id.description:
Returns the proposal ID that will be assigned to the
next proposal created.

proposal_count.description: Returns the number of proposals that have been created in this module.

proposal_creation_policy.description: Gets the current proposal creation policy for this module.

proposal_hooks.description: Lists all of the consumers of proposal hooks for this module.

reverse_proposals.description:
Lists all of the proposals that have been cast in this module
in decending order of proposal ID.

limit.description:
The maximum number of proposals to return as part of this
query. If no limit is set a max of 30 proposals will be
returned.

start_before.description:
The proposal ID to start listing proposals before. For
example, if this is set to 6 proposals with IDs 5 and
lower will be returned.

vote_hooks.description: Lists all of the consumers of vote hooks for this module.
